create_cost_function_reward: create a CostFunctionReward instance with a cost function and init cost function for LLVM reward computation
build_normalized_reward: build a NormalizedReward that normalizes cost function rewards to the initial observation value
create_baseline_improvement_normalized_r: create a BaselineImprovementNormalizedReward that normalizes rewards by the improvement made by a baseline approach
review_cost_function_reward_update: review the CostFunctionReward update method to understand how incremental reward is computed from cost differences
refactor_normalized_reward_get_cost_norm: refactor the NormalizedReward get_cost_norm method to customize how cost normalization values are derived
